nodes.title: Prompt C for the caller judge (product/shared/safety/prompts/caller_crisis.c.txt, for --prompt-file): B's anchored 0-100 crisis risk scale plus A's opt-out section (exclusion list word for word), in one call, written as shapes. 2,398 characters, 406 words, about 600 tokens, against A's 2,575 / 438 / ~644 and B's 3,067 / 531 / ~767. B's opt-out text was already identical to A's, so B's opt-out loss tracks its length and its timeouts (20/260 against 7/260), not the opt-out wording. C is shorter than A. Both doors parse its output (tests). Proposed rule: research/2026-10-24/judge-prereg10/PREREG-DRAFT.md, for the integrator to fix and sign before any request.
nodes.value: a candidate that keeps B's crisis gain without B's opt-out loss

events.details: Prompt C written (shorter than A), parse parity in both doors, PREREG-10 draft for the integrator. The prompt-B switch is dropped (judge.json keeps A). The brief-review prompt is unchanged until all three blind scores arrive.
